title: YNET is messaging, never a drop box
text: YNET is a KERNEL realtime QHSM/QMSM messaging board. It uses IROH for cross-host messaging and in-memory yngenios kernel messages with WAL durability. It is NOT a file-based message board and NOT a drop box. COOP is the file-based drop-box channel and remains correct for DOCUMENTS. Engineer directive 2026-09-07.
evidence: engineer directive, 2026-09-07

title: WAL durability is a requirement, not an implementation detail
text: In-memory kernel messages MUST be WAL-durable. A message that is only in memory is lost on the restart that liveness machinery exists to survive; a leader that cannot replay its in-flight intents after a restart re-drives from zero. This binds W-18's Intent/Outcome write-ahead requirement to the transport: the WAL is where Intent lands BEFORE the act, and Outcome after.
evidence: engineer directive 2026-09-07 (in memory + WAL durability); W-18 resumable programme

title: Three always-alive actor tiers, all QHSM/QMSM .NET C#
text: (a) ONE fleet LEADER. (b) ONE HOST coordinator per host, helping the leader and its lanes coordinate. (c) ONE LANE sub-coordinator per lane. All three are QHSM/QMSM .NET C# actors and MUST always be alive -- resident from process start, never started only after winning a role.

title: Guardian and broker keep the leader alive; 2-minute kernel-mailbox liveness
text: Guardians, helped by brokers, MUST keep the leader alive at all times, and on failure MUST immediately elect and restart a new leader for the entire fleet. Liveness is checked EVERY 2 MINUTES by a YNET/kernel realtime message to the actor's MAILBOX. Never file-based, ever. Liveness is proven ONLY by answering a nonced challenge round-trip within T_resp -- never by process existence, never by a status verb, never by an unexpired lease.

text: A CI-enforceable gate MUST assert that the realtime path carries no filesystem dependency, because a file adapter satisfies a transport-agnostic interface and every test -- a file carrier and a kernel mailbox produce IDENTICAL GREEN SUITES. title: Rollout evidence is DERIVED per lane per host, never self-reported
text: Fleetwide deployment is tracked as one row per lane per host (4 hosts x 15 lanes = 60 rows): {host, lane, repo, gate_exit_code, carriers_declared, carriers_live, undeclared, coordinator_tier_present, watcher_ping_medium, leaderping_bind_address, roundtrip_ms, commit_sha, utc, verdict}. The VERDICT is derived from the gate's own JSON output and the probe's own response; a lane never types its own verdict. A lane that cannot run the probe reports UNVERIFIABLE -- never PASS and never FAIL. This exists because no artefact in this estate can currently answer 'is this live on all 60 lanes', which makes every 'rolled out fleetwide' claim unverified by construction, the same defect section 9 names for the ratification tally.

title: A negative claim about the fleet requires a positive control
text: Before publishing 'X does not exist', the instrument MUST first be shown to detect X when X IS present. Absent that demonstration the honest verdict is UNVERIFIABLE -- never ABSENT, never REFUSE. Where two instruments disagree, that is evidence about the INSTRUMENTS, and the one reporting the emptier world is distrusted first.

title: Sequencing: the coordinator tiers must NOT precede the transport
text: FR-03's host and lane coordinator tiers are pure C# and need no listener, which makes building them first extremely tempting. Doing so means THREE actor tiers built on the interim file carrier, each of which must then be migrated -- multiplying the transport work by the number of tiers and tripling the surface on which 'the interim became permanent' can happen. REQUIRED ORDER: listener/transport -> swap behind IYnetInboundPush/IYnetInboundPull with state machines UNTOUCHED -> DELETE the carriers (never disable, W-18) -> only then replicate the resident-actor pattern into the coordinator tiers.

Objections must cite a clause_id and carry a measurement. This clause is itself submitted under its own rule and is the one most likely to need amendment.

text: Who owns binding the LeaderPing endpoints off loopback? FR-05 measures them loopback-only on GAVRIELLA and SHIRAS. If it does not, this is a small wiring change someone can make today and the whole watch tier unblocks. If it does, it waits on glpnet. THIS AMBIGUITY IS ON THE CRITICAL PATH AND NEEDS A RULING.

Is the 2-minute cadence of FR-04 a MAXIMUM interval or a target? W-18 requires the grace be N_miss x T_ping 'tuned by measurement, not taste'. With T_ping = 120 s, even N_miss = 2 means a dead leader goes unnoticed for 4 minutes. Measured round-trip on GAVRIELLA is 11-14 ms, so a far tighter T_ping is affordable. Proposed reading: 2 minutes is the MAXIMUM permitted staleness, and the actual T_ping is set by measurement well below it. Needs an engineer or fleet ruling before watchers are built to a number.

text: MAXIMUM interval, not a target, and the grace must be derived from it rather than fixed independently. W-18: the grace is N_miss x T_ping, tuned by MEASUREMENT not taste. So T_ping <= 120s is the requirement and detection latency is N_miss x T_ping; stating a grace in seconds independent of T_ping lets the two drift and reintroduces the timer anti-pattern OB-4 retired. RECOMMEND: T_ping = 120s max, N_miss = 3, detection <= 360s, and both values carried as DATA on the NoConfidence record (L0's NoConfidence already has GraceMisses and PingInterval fields) so a verdict can be read against the policy that produced it.
